title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Rate Card — Dispute Handling Credit on Large Invoice Disputes
content:
A large invoice dispute settled in the business's favor on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account carries a flat dispute handling credit within the dispute settlement credit, set by the size of the dispute and the age of the account.

| Disputed amount on the approved request | Account age | Dispute handling credit |
|---|---|---|
| At least 1500.00 | At least 60 whole months | 75.00 (long-standing handling credit) |
| At least 1500.00 | Less than 60 whole months | 40.00 (newer-account handling credit) |
| Below 1500.00 | Any | Zero |

Account age is counted in whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the date the dispute credit is posted.

## Boundaries (hypothetical)

- Disputed 1500.00, account open 60 whole months: 75.00. Disputed 1499.99, same account: zero.
- Disputed 2250.00, account open 59 whole months: 40.00.
- Account opened 14 June, credit posted 13 June five years later: 59 whole months, so 40.00 on a dispute of at least 1500.00; posted on 14 June five years later: 60 whole months, so 75.00.

The handling credit is a flat amount added within the dispute settlement credit.
